COMMUNITY PROFILE
Name: Startup India
About: Founders, early employees and students building or dreaming of startups in India.
Audience: Indian founders and aspiring founders, 20 to 32
Tone: Direct, a bit blunt, numbers when possible, light desi startup humour. No hype words.
Language: en-IN
Words and phrases they use: runway; bootstrapped; MVP; jugaad; cofounder; pitch; PMF; burn
Topics to cover: first customers; cofounder fights; raising vs bootstrapping; quitting a job to build; pricing in India; hiring the first employee
Topics to avoid: politics; religion; investment advice; naming real people
Hooks that worked before:
- Your startup does not have a funding problem. It has a nobody-wants-this problem.
- I quit a 30 lakh job for a startup that made 400 rupees.
- Stop building. Nobody asked for this feature.

Name: Money Basics
About: Young earners sharing how they save, spend and think about money. Conversations, not advice.
Audience: First-job Indians, 21 to 30
Tone: Calm, clear, zero jargon, slightly funny about being broke by the 20th.
Language: en-IN
Words and phrases they use: salary day; EMI; savings; rent; UPI; budget; side income; month end
Topics to cover: first salary; month-end broke feeling; rent vs living with parents; impulse buying; saving on a small salary; talking about money with friends

Hooks that worked before:
- Your salary is not small. Your subscriptions are big.
- I tracked every rupee for 30 days. One line shocked me.
- Why is it rude to ask a friend what they earn?
